children: This means you have access to Empower's financial tools--connect other accounts, create a budget, debt payoff plan, savings plan for future purchases, track your net worth, and more.
You can log in after your first month at Redmond and use the tools, submit roll overs, or make changes that will apply when you're eligible to participate.

bullets.text: All associates age 18 and older are eligible to participate after 6 months, and are automatically enrolled into the default option
children: The default is a 4% contribution into the Roth option & target date fund.
If you only contribute 4%, you won't receive all the money Redmond wants to give you.
Log in to Empower and increase your contribution to at least 8%. That way, you'll get all of Redmond's match.

children.text: You own 100% of your contributions, but Redmond’s contribution has a vesting period.
children: This means that you won't keep the Redmond match until you've worked at least 1,000 hours per year for two years

pages.title: Say “Yes!” To Free Money
bullets: If you’re not contributing at least 8% of your paycheck, you’re saying no to money that Redmond wants to give you.
Redmond contributes about half of what you contribute up to 4%
If you only contribute 4%, Redmond will contribute 2.5%
If you contribute 8% or more, Redmond will contribute 4%

pages.title: Example: Associate Earning $2,000 Biweekly
bullets: Your contribution is 100% yours no matter how long you stay with Redmond
Redmond’s contribution is subject to “vesting” and isn’t 100% yours until you’ve been an employee for the entire vesting period
